summary: Tests the money reader against many example sentences and checks it reads amounts correctly or refuses them.
purpose: Guard the money parser against known mistakes, such as reading a year as an amount.
why: Reason not stated in the code, though the test names describe the mistakes they prevent.
how: Each test runs the parser on a sentence, then checks the amount, currency, or refusal reason. A helper compares only the fields listed.
inputs: Example sentences defined in the file.
outputs: A pass or fail result for each test, with a message showing the value that did not match.
risks: Only the listed examples are covered, so new wording needs a new test.
debug: Run this file. The failing test name points to the sentence, then compare that sentence with the rules in money.ts.
